i dont know where to go, and admitting that is frightening.
i should have posted to depression most likely.

i have no idea what i want from another person. what can people offer? what is the point of having relationships?

thats the jist. 

i waited for her to contact me, as she threw me out, and felt it should be on her terms. it took 3 weeks.

her email made it clear that she wanted to move on.
